column1: # Stage S2 — apps and deploy. Paths name the tree before the moves (after S1).
# deploy folder first: same depth as the apps/website rows, so its line comes first
# API goldens out of the frontend; the URL case table into its crate folder
# the shared folder lands as the crate's src/ (its README at the crate root), so the folder
# keeps one mapping and the table's own `/` literals keep naming their folder
# crate paths in Rust code (scopes name folders before the moves)
# package names: Cargo keys, dep: features, -p arguments, prose
# library names written without a path: [lib] name, doc prose, regex text, fixtures
# the fleet host agent everywhere but Markdown, whose glossary anchors spell #fleet-host-agent
# the Caddyfile's in-container name follows its new file name
